title: 自定义序列化：default 钩子 / to_json / Encoder 子类与反序列化还原
expected_output:
=== 直接 dumps: 三种类型都不可序列化 ===
  Decimal  -> TypeError: Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable
  datetime -> TypeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable
  自定义类     -> TypeError: Object of type Order is not JSON serializable

=== 方案 A: default= 钩子（按类型兜底）===
{"amount": "19.90", "created": "2026-10-08T12:00:00+00:00"}

=== 方案 B: 显式 to_json（推荐：契约显式、可控）===
{"oid": "A-1001", "amount": "19.90", "created": "2026-10-08T12:00:00+00:00"}

=== 方案 C: 自定义 JSONEncoder 子类 ===
{"oid": "A-1001", "amount": "19.90", "created": "2026-10-08T12:00:00+00:00"}

=== 反序列化: 类型不会自动回来 ===
loads 结果      = {'oid': 'A-1001', 'amount': '19.90', 'created': '2026-10-08T12:00:00+00:00'}
amount 类型     = str (str, 需自己 Decimal(...))
created 类型    = str (str, 需自己 datetime.fromisoformat(...))
fromisoformat   = 2026-10-08 12:00:00+00:00

=== 结论 ===
序列化策略优先级: 显式 to_json > default 钩子 > Encoder 子类; 反序列化必须显式还原类型
